cc:Work.dc:title: fig1 aer paired predictor contrasts
cc:Work.dc:description: Paired MAE differences on the same 150 source_sha256 groups for a single local Aer q9 warm-execution target. Positive delta means the named candidate has worse MAE. Intervals are the 10,000-replicate 95% grouped percentile bootstrap intervals from the aggregate and are unadjusted for multiple comparisons.
